mapper.sql: TEMPLATE_ID, TEMPLATE_NAME, TEMPLATE_TYPE, QUERY_SQL, QUERY_PARAMS, RESULT_FIELDS, TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTION, ENABLED, IS_PUBLIC, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE WHERE TEMPLATE_TYPE = #{templateType} AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY TEMPLATE_NAME
SELECT FROM SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE WHERE CREATE_BY = #{createBy} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE WHERE IS_PUBLIC = 1 AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY TEMPLATE_NAME
SELECT FROM SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE WHERE ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY TEMPLATE_NAME
mapper.update: UPDATE SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE SET ENABLED = #{enabled}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW()SYSDATE WHERE TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId}

UPDATE SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE SET ENABLED = #{enabled}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW()SYSDATE WHERE TEMPLATE_ID IN
#{templateId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalTemplates, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENABLED = 1 THEN 1 END) AS enabledTemplates, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENABLED = 0 THEN 1 END) AS disabledTemplates, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_PUBLIC = 1 THEN 1 END) AS publicTemplates, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_PUBLIC = 0 THEN 1 END) AS privateTemplates, COUNT(DISTINCT TEMPLATE_TYPE) AS templateTypes, COUNT(DISTINCT CREATE_BY) AS creators FROM SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE

SELECT TEMPLATE_TYPE AS type, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE GROUP BY TEMPLATE_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT t.TEMPLATE_ID AS templateId, t.TEMPLATE_NAME AS templateName, t.TEMPLATE_TYPE AS templateType, 0 AS usageCount, t.CREATE_TIME AS createTime FROM SYS_QUERY_TEMPLATE t WHERE t.ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY t.CREATE_TIME DESC
LIMIT 20
AND ROWNUM <= 20
